body:
The second report from the phones, Settings showing only their header on Tomek's iPhone 13 mini, now has a cause and a fix. A photo of the phone showed the whole part below the header at zero height. That part was laid out in a way newer versions of the phone's browser engine size from its content and older ones give no height at all. It is now laid out the way the other dialogs are.

The host is updated, so it takes effect when the app is reopened; no TestFlight update is needed.

This could not be reproduced here: the simulator only has iOS 27, where Settings were always visible. The fix follows from the photo and the code, and Settings look the same as before on the simulator. Tomek opening Settings again is the confirmation.

Details: progress/2026-10-10-dialog-safe-area.md.

metadata.summary: Settings showing only their header on one iPhone: cause found from a photo, fix deployed, awaiting confirmation
